subject.title: [Feature]: Integrate OpenSSF Best Practices & Tooling into OpenClaw

question: Which remaining OpenSSF supply-chain controls should OpenClaw adopt now, and which should be deferred, replaced by existing safeguards, or handled through repository or organization administration outside the source tree?
rationale: The remaining work changes trusted CI execution, release identity, scanner gates, GitHub/org policy, and artifact trust, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent security posture or rollout order.

options.title: Split And Phase Selected Controls
options.body: Keep this umbrella open, split owner-approved slices for Scorecard/badges, SECURITY-INSIGHTS, scanner gates, release attestations, and org settings, and validate each slice on the relevant workflow or release path.

options.title: Keep As Tracking Only
options.body: Use this issue as a standing security roadmap item and require separate maintainer-authored issues or PRs before implementation work starts.

options.title: Defer OpenSSF Program
options.body: Close or pause the OpenSSF-specific program only if maintainers explicitly decide current SECURITY.md, Dependabot, Dependency Guard, CodeQL, provenance, and attestations are sufficient substitutes for now.

recommendation.title: Split And Phase Selected Controls
recommendation.body: Keep this umbrella open, split owner-approved slices for Scorecard/badges, SECURITY-INSIGHTS, scanner gates, release attestations, and org settings, and validate each slice on the relevant workflow or release path.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the project lead, owns CODEOWNERS routing, and already engaged on this tracker, making him the best available decision owner for cross-cutting security/release/admin direction.
